biomarkers.name: SMARCB1 (INI-1) loss
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining feature in most ATRTs; loss of nuclear INI1 expression supports diagnosis. Germline testing is recommended to evaluate rhabdoid tumour predisposition syndrome

biomarkers.name: SMARCA4 (BRG1) loss
biomarkers.clinical_use: Alternative defining driver in a small subset; loss of BRG1 supports ATRT diagnosis when SMARCB1 is retained

biomarkers.name: Methylation subgroups (ATRT-TYR, ATRT-SHH, ATRT-MYC)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Molecular subclassification with clinicobiologic and prognostic associations; ATRT-TYR often occurs in younger children and has relatively more favorable outcomes, ATRT-SHH is intermediate, and ATRT-MYC is generally associated with less favorable outcomes

biomarkers.name: SMARCB1 germline
biomarkers.clinical_use: Rhabdoid tumour predisposition syndrome — surveillance and family counseling

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Rhabdoid cells (large eccentric nuclei with prominent nucleoli and eosinophilic paranuclear cytoplasmic inclusions) mixed with primitive neuroectodermal or teratoid/epithelial/mesenchymal components
variants: ATRT-TYR (younger children/infants, tyrosinase expression, relatively better prognosis)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Not well characterised; SMARCB1 loss may affect immune signalling

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Uncertain — proposed neural progenitor/early embryonal precursor cells with SMARCB1 loss driving a distinctive undifferentiated phenotype
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Undifferentiated / rhabdoid — polymorphic small round blue cells with rhabdoid cells; multi-lineage IHC (cytokeratin+, GFAP+, EMA+, SMA+ — often positive for markers of multiple lineages simultaneously)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: SMARCB1 (INI-1) loss disrupts the SWI/SNF chromatin remodelling complex, contributing to lineage infidelity/plasticity with concurrent expression of markers from multiple lineages
